description: Full pre-payment dossier for one agent: ERC-8004 identity, sybil forensics, feedback-velocity class (organic/burst/farm) and 30d liveness compliance, with an ok / caution / avoid verdict. Use it when you are integrating an agent or paying it repeatedly — it bundles the trust-gate, forensics and SLA answers in one call. REST: GET /api/v1/agent/{agent_id}/trust-passport ($0.01).
